posts.text:
The Major Richard Star Act ends the so called “wounded veteran tax,” an unfair reduction in retirement pay for combat-injured veterans.

House Republicans refused to put this legislation on the floor without making cuts to other veterans’ benefits. So Democrats went around them https://t.co/8W79sleDlZ

I hope everyone takes a good hard look at this picture.

Trump’s under-construction ballroom is now bigger than the rest of the White House. Much bigger.

The contrast says everything you need to know about this President and his priorities. https://t.co/hrN0BPB4ri

For 35 years, retired Vice Admiral Nancy Lacore served our country honorably in the United States Navy.

I'm honored to work with Congresswoman-elect Lacore next year as she continues her lifetime of service representing the people of South Carolina's 1st Congressional District. https://t.co/wKbsUwK8jT

It was an immense pleasure to meet with Senator-elect Annie Andrews today.

I look forward to working with her to make life more affordable and our country’s greatness accessible to all South Carolinians. https://t.co/xMtFNS4Y1i

On Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who served our country and the families who sacrificed alongside them. Their courage, service, and commitment to our nation deserve more than our gratitude. They deserve our unwavering support.

That’s why this week I’m looking

A week later, the President’s focus is not on how to work with Democrats to bring down costs and deliver the real change Americans are demanding.

No, he’s focused on sowing distrust in our voting system and questioning the election results. https://t.co/Rsw0EiASyb

Following this week's overwhelming verdict from American voters that the Trump Administration has utterly failed on affordability, you might have expected, or at least hoped for, personnel changes elevating officials with a track record of economic policy success.

Instead, Trump has promoted Stephen Miller, known not for improving Americans' lives but for:

Defending the Confederate flag following the 2015 white supremacist shooting at Mother Emanuel AME Church in Charleston;
Suggesting the suspension habeas corpus, the constitutional right to challenge unlawful detention; and

Orchestrating Trump’s mass deportation operation, which has unleashed masked ICE agents on American communities, resulted in the deaths of American citizens, and left hardworking immigrants detained indefinitely in secretive detention centers.

This is the man Trump chose as his new Chief of Staff.

Congressional Democrats will not tolerate Stephen Miller’s racist policies and rhetoric, which serve only to divide Americans and distract from the real challenges facing American families.

Instead of signing bills to make your life better, Trump is signing a document to try to prevent the next President from taking down his tacky gold decorations in the Oval Office. https://t.co/KBWuNE2p7m
After everything that’s happened, this man is still focused on his ballroom. https://t.co/TqMDHOiUn7

Trump's war has been such a disaster for American families.

But it's been great financially for the oil industry, and those who are invested in it like President Trump.

This war must end. We're tired of lining the pockets of big oil companies due to Trump's reckless decisions. https://t.co/5DczA0OXG5

Before Trump took office, the inflation rate was projected to be back down to near pre-covid levels by the end of 2026.

Instead, Trump’s dumb tariffs and war sent prices soaring while he personally got billions of dollars richer.

The American people are done with Trump’s corruption, his lies, and his foolish decisions.

Unbelievable. Trump’s failed war in Iran has cost American taxpayers $47,000,000,000.

That’s on top of the 160 billion Americans are paying in higher fuel costs. 

None of this was necessary. Trump’s presidency has been a disaster.
https://t.co/DY4S2x2XLf

Here we go again.

As soon as the midterm elections pass, Trump is reportedly planning to restart intense military actions in Iran. That’s likely going to mean even higher gas prices than we have now.

Americans are sick and tired of paying the price for Trump’s dumb war.
https://t.co/yMNjeN7If1

Trump bragged about oil companies profiting from the high gas prices caused by his war.

Trump himself is profiting from his investments in oil companies.

Now he’s moving to make it even easier for these companies to grow their profits by weakening rules designed to stop harmful

In Trump’s America, if you’re a criminal who’s been ordered to pay restitution to victims, you can get out of it if you’re wealthy and well-connected to the White House.

Trump’s pardons and commutations have wiped out $1.1 billion in fines and restitution.

As usual, Trump sided with the criminals and left victims empty-handed.
https://t.co/uVOazpU6oZ

When Trump says the U.S. is “making money like we’ve never made before” off high gas prices, he means HE is making a ton of money off high gas prices.

This war is leaving you with less money. It’s leaving Trump with more. https://t.co/KHsevzbqtn

Election Day is just over a week away!

South Carolina’s early voting locations are open this week Monday through Saturday from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m.

Election Day polling places will be open Tuesday, November 3, from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Mail ballots must reach your county voter

Donald Trump and his friends have looted our government for their own benefit.

The American people know exactly what’s happening.

Democrats will investigate their corruption.
https://t.co/NLR3JUgQ1i

Yet another example of the people in Trump’s orbit rushing to cash in on his presidency.

Trump’s former personal lawyer and U.S. attorney for New Jersey secured a $50 million employment deal from the family of a Venezuelan billionaire banker seeking a pardon. Weeks after

Russia has murdered over 17,000 civilians in Ukraine.

They’ve abducted over 20,000 children.

Trump and his administration are quick to praise Russia and Putin but never miss an opportunity to criticize Zelenksy and undermine Ukraine’s ability to defend itself. Which side are they on?

Secret Service resources → $415M for White House Ballroom Construction

Missile modernization program → Renovation of Trump’s Qatari-gifted jet

DHS commemorative activities → $20M for pro-Trump television ads

If anyone needs to be investigated for fraud, it needs to be President Trump.

This administration thinks so little of the American people.

They start a senseless war that sends farmers’ diesel prices soaring, and then pretend to rescue them from the prices they drove up.

American farmers are not stupid. https://t.co/sEeosYUrap

Diwali reminds us that even in challenging times, the light of hope can guide us forward.

May this year’s Festival of Lights inspire us to lead with kindness and work toward a brighter future for all. Happy Diwali to everyone celebrating!

This is real rich. The President who’s corrupted, wasted, and abused your taxpayer dollars for his own benefit is launching an anti-fraud program to distract from his own actions.

I’d submit the president himself for consideration, but in true Trump fashion, he’s already https://t.co/copLEIBvx5

I just want to remind people what nearly two years of Trump’s presidency—with Republicans controlling Congress and backing him every step of the way—have brought us:

Sweeping tariffs costing households more than $1,000 a year.

A law that is kicking millions of Americans off

Early voting for the November 3 midterm elections begins today in South Carolina.

Early voting centers are open Monday - Saturday from 8:30am – 6pm.

Locate your nearest early voting location below.
https://t.co/wJzITj4ECo
Finally, the President is taking on an issue every American is talking about. https://t.co/4OkQaQHiNp

What an insult to Sen. Lindsey Graham’s memory and legacy.

More importantly, what a betrayal of America’s values and interests.

Republicans in Congress who claim to share the late Sen. Graham’s principled commitment to the defense of freedom in Ukraine must join Democrats in acting to override this president’s disgraceful appeasement of his pal Putin.

This whole administration is unbelievably corrupt.

Trump’s former personal lawyer allegedly sought to buy Trump’s favor through a $5.6 million Kennedy Center donation intended to protect her husband’s business interests in Venezuela.

Then, last week, she stormed into the Oval Office, exasperated, claiming that the Trump appointee who arranged the payment had directed the money to a defense contractor he had previously worked for instead.

Trump’s allies are doing everything they can to cash in on Trump’s presidency while they have the chance. Pay to play is the name of the game.
https://t.co/Pal2SAXuma

I’m heartbroken by the shooting at an elementary school in Oregon that killed three children and a teacher and wounded others. My prayers are with the victims’ families, the students, and the entire Bend community.

These shootings are far too common. It is long past time for Republicans in Congress to join Democrats and pass commonsense gun reform legislation to help prevent these tragedies and protect our children. No family should have to endure this heartbreak.https://t.co/H1gm5a3YcA

New documents have revealed the donors to Trump’s ballroom.

Tens of millions of dollars came from big tech and artificial intelligence companies—the very companies that stand to benefit from Trump’s reckless push to block AI regulation.

Companies whose futures are heavily influenced by Trump’s decisions are bankrolling his personal pet project. The conflicts of interest are glaring.
https://t.co/5f4vTKLXyq

Wholesale inflation—which tracks prices businesses pay before they reach consumers—hit 6.3% in September, its highest level in nearly four years.

This suggests Trump’s war is driving up energy costs for businesses, and those costs are soon likely to get passed on to you.

This war has been a disaster. This presidency has been a disaster. The American people have had enough.

Shockingly, it turns out the American people don’t want their President to spend his time enriching himself, his family, and his billionaire donors while kicking millions off health care—and not just do nothing about high prices, but actively cause prices to go up.

Who would have thought!

75% of Americans think President Trump has prioritized his business interests over the country since taking office in 2025, according to a new poll.

Americans want to know if Trump and his family are profiting off the Presidency. Democrats are determined to find out.
https://t.co/m93c2JGsnn

Just days ago, Trump eased sanctions on Russian diesel and claimed Russia agreed to stop attacking energy infrastructure.

After Russia’s massive attacks on Ukraine’s energy facilities last night, it’s clear they took Trump’s money and ran.

What a weak, weak President.
https://t.co/u32kHkf5B4

This morning’s inflation report showed inflation increased substantially last month. I just want to remind people: It didn’t have to be this way.
 
Inflation was trending down for over two years before Trump took office. It was projected to fall to 2.1% in 2026, near the Fed’s target. Trump could have just stayed the course.
 
Instead, his senseless tariffs and dumb war have shot inflation back up, with no relief from high prices in sight.

What a mistake. Trump’s decision to ease sanctions on Russian diesel will do little to lower U.S. fuel prices but a lot to fund Russia’s war against our ally Ukraine.

The simplest way to bring prices down is to end the war with Iran once and for all.
https://t.co/IpaHm68nhB
If only Trump showed as much passion for ending the war and lowering costs as he does for his ballroom and helipad. https://t.co/aaYotNFyCZ

On Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we honor Native Americans’ enduring contributions as our nation’s first inhabitants. 

May we continue to celebrate their histories, cultural heritage, traditions, and their legacies for generations to come.

When Donald Trump took office and he had the opportunity to lower costs, his actions did the opposite.

Always remember that.
https://t.co/IyHj4zn9Fw

Americans: I’m worried about data centers driving up my electricity bills and AI threatening my job security.

Trump: If you don’t call AI Super Intelligence, you are the enemy! https://t.co/cVisPes0Sl

Understand what this means: Trump knows the war is causing prices to rise, he’s afraid voters will punish him in the midterms if they rise further, so instead, he’s waiting until after the election to double down on his war.

He’s trying to fool you into believing that the worst of the high prices is behind us, when in reality, the worst could still be to come.

New York Fed Report: Trump's tariffs added 2.9 percentage points to consumer goods inflation by February 2026. Without the tariffs, prices of goods would have fallen. New Canadian tariffs are expected to put additional upward pressure on prices.

These tariffs continue to be a disaster for Americans, yet President Trump just keeps doubling down.
https://t.co/LuOBtvS3vV

The Trump administration has spent nearly fifty billion taxpayer dollars on a senseless war that is raising your costs.

Meanwhile, Trump’s sons could be potentially profiting from the war, as defense companies they’ve invested in receive new government contracts.

The Trump administration and his family must be thoroughly investigated and held accountable for these conflicts of interest.

Three years ago today, Hamas carried out the deadliest attack in Israel’s history, killing 1,200 people and taking 251 more hostage. This heinous attack inflicted profound pain on Jewish communities in Israel and around the world.

The innocent people whose lives were shattered on that day—and all of the far too many innocent people whose lives have been shattered on far too many days during this conflict—deserved to live their lives with security and dignity. 

In their honor, people of good will must rededicate ourselves to the difficult work of building a future of peace and freedom for Israelis and Palestinians alike.

I have no idea what Trump meant by “Let them take out Los Angeles,” but I do know this: his argument that high gas prices are a “small price to pay” to prevent Iran from having a nuclear weapon is complete nonsense.

Iran didn’t have a nuclear weapon under the previous deal negotiated by Obama. We didn’t have high gas prices. Our military bases weren’t under bombardment. We weren’t running out of critical munitions.

Those things are all a result of Trump tearing up that deal and choosing instead to start a war—a war that has already cost taxpayers nearly fifty billion dollars, with Americans paying even more at the pump.

Trump will keep using the “small price to pay” line. Don’t fall for it.

I tried out Trump’s new AI website. 

I know this may shock people, but according to https://t.co/W0h3wfLn75, it seems as though Trump has been lying to people. https://t.co/SQ09VGnh1e

Absolutely no surprise that the President who was found liable for sexual abuse by a federal jury says he “feels badly” for the men being investigated by the NY Attorney General in the Cornell rape case. 

Despicable. https://t.co/NDbT4w7ed9
This is year 11 of Trump claiming he’s going to pass a new health care plan. https://t.co/iRpGUqyzvI

Seems Trump is jumpstarting grade inflation just as much as he has jumpstarted price inflation.
 
Inflation should be 2%. Trump's grade on the economy should be an F. https://t.co/CcDF2pmDRp

My thoughts are with everyone affected by this morning’s crash on I-95 over Lake Marion.

Our amazing first responders acted swiftly, rescued those trapped, cared for the injured, and kept other motorists safe. I hope all those injured make a full and speedy recovery.

Some new changes to SNAP go into effect today thanks to Trump and Republicans’ “big, beautiful bill.”

States are going to have to pick up more of the cost of administering the program, which could force some states to make additional cuts to benefits.
